strips.title: A cold week with a heated throw — in real life

panels.head: Read the label
panels.text: Find the model number before the first night and compare it with the recall list.

panels.head: Lay it flat
panels.text: On top of the sheet, controller outside the covers, plugged into the wall.

panels.head: Test the auto-off
panels.text: Stay awake once and time it; stop if the controller gets hot.

panels.head: Switch it off
panels.text: Preheat, then turn it off before you get in, as UL Solutions suggests.
